land.pilot: Now piloting in the San Francisco Bay Area

land.p: From San Francisco to Mumbai, neighbors leave sealed, labeled meals at community fridges and shelves. Anyone who needs food can find one nearby, free, with no questions asked.
land.note: No account needed. Free for everyone.
side.p: Home-cooked boxes and groceries left by neighbors at fridges and shelves in cities around the world.
fine: Demo only. Eternal Pot is a concept inspired by the Akshaya Patra Foundation's mission that no one should go hungry. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Akshaya Patra. All listings are sample data.
land.orgs: NGOs and city councils: post job trainings, community meals and hunger events.
atlas.eyebrow: Rooted in neighbors. Connected by food.
atlas.p: Tap a circle to zoom in or open a drop point. Tap anywhere else to set where you are.

give.t1: Let cooked food cool, then seal it within 2 hours of cooking.
give.t2: One meal per container. Wrap the box so it stays closed.
give.t3: Mark nuts, dairy, eggs, shellfish and meat clearly.
give.t4: Put cooked food in a fridge point if the box says it needs a fridge.
give.t5: Drop it off during open hours and list it right away.

give.errPledge: Please confirm the food is sealed and safe to share.
